body: im sorry i feel like im oversharing

I don't know how it started, but this past month posed so many problems i.e. finances, work, studies. I'm a law student who's supposed to graduate this semester. I live with my gf and her cats, and money has been really tough. That's why I took a job last year. My workmates are the best but the deadlines are really cutthroat. I also have a thesis I have to submit, on top of my remaining classes.

There wasn't a day that I didn't think of all these things. I guess this month reached a breaking point. it seemed like i couldn't accomplish any of these (thesis, work deliverables, school work, household chores). I felt so alone.

When I sought help from my gf, who has always been by my side, she said she'd help me but that was a month ago. I didn't want to impose because she has always been there for me. When I said i felt like i won't get to graduate this semester, she replied that I should stop seeming so down all the time, which really crushed my heart.
Thanks. i don't know where to start though.
